name: Hornbill Festival
description: The 'Festival of Festivals' showcasing traditional music, warrior dances, indigenous crafts, and culinary heritage of 17 Naga tribes at Kisama Village.

name: Rongali Bihu
description: Assam's spring harvest celebration featuring vibrant Bihu dance, dhol drumming, pepa horn performances, and traditional feast preparations.

name: Wangala Festival
description: The 100-Drums Wangala Festival of the Garo tribe honoring Saljong, the Sun God, with synchronised drum rhythms and traditional horn headgear dances.

name: Chapchar Kut
description: Mizoram's joyful spring festival celebrated after clearing jungle lands, featuring Cheraw bamboo dance and traditional Mizo songs.

name: Sangai Festival
description: A grand cultural extravaganza promoting Manipur's classical Ras Leela dance, Thang-Ta martial arts, and indigenous Sagol Kangjei (Polo).

name: Losar Festival
description: Tibetan and Monpa New Year marked by colorful Cham masked dances in ancient monasteries, prayer flags, and community feasts.

name: Ambubachi Mela
description: The annual Tantric festival held at the historic Kamakhya Temple in Guwahati, drawing thousands of ascetics and pilgrims.
